assay: bulk RNA-seq of mouse nigral/midbrain tissue (S4.16.p1); GEO series holds two experiments: irisin pre-treatment (Control/MPTP/Irisin+MPTP, n=3 each) and irisin delayed treatment (Control/Irisin/MPTP/MPTP+Irisin, n=3 each)
primary_estimand: Effect of exogenous recombinant irisin (i.p. 200 ug/kg/d, 5 days) on the midbrain transcriptome of MPTP-treated mice (S2.5.p1, FIG4). Exercise appears only in the human cohort (S2.1.p1: 23 PD patients, 12-week exercise, serum irisin ELISA, no transcriptomics). No sequenced sample received exercise.
sample_inclusion: male C57BL/6 mice, 6 weeks (GEO characteristics); n=3 per group
planned_contrasts: Irisin+MPTP vs MPTP (pre-treatment), GSEA only (S2.5.p1, Supplementary Fig. 3a-b, Fig. 4a); paper reports no DEG count
MPTP+Irisin vs MPTP (delayed treatment), GSEA only (S2.5.p1, Supplementary Fig. 3c-d, Fig. 4b); paper reports no DEG count
paper_method: featureCounts read counts; downstream analysis in R (S4.16.p1), DE method not named; GEO data_processing: StringTie/edgeR expression, DE |log2FC| >= 1 and p < 0.05

paper_threshold.source_locator: GEO data_processing (not in the article text); article reports GSEA only

paper_results: GSEA pathways (NAD(P)H oxidoreductase activity, focal adhesion, PI3K-Akt, MAPK); no DEG counts or gene lists in the article
